purpose: Section 25: confirm, under the FINAL evaluator configuration of this phase (Workstream A's frozen matcher, evaluation-v2-algorithm.v3), that all 14 historically-confirmed false credits remain caught - none silently re-upheld. This check is entirely INDEPENDENT of the taxonomy-reproducibility outcome (12/17/18) - it concerns only the binary credit/no-credit determination, which the reproducibility study itself separately corroborated as unanimous.

evidenceLayer1_engineTest.result: PASS (4/4 tests, part of the 117/117 evaluation-v2 suite confirmed at Workstream A's freeze - 05-matcher-freeze.json)
evidenceLayer1_engineTest.note: Re-verified as part of this phase's final full regression run (see 31-required-gates in the narrative report) - unchanged since Workstream A froze the matcher; this test suite was not touched during Workstream B (the taxonomy study made zero changes to lib/contract-model/evaluation-v2/).

evidenceLayer2_independentAdjudicatorCro.result: All 14 controls received unanimous NO_CREDIT from all three independently-dispatched, mutually-blind adjudicators, who had no access to V2's disposition, the matcher's code, or any historical false-credit record.
evidenceLayer2_independentAdjudicatorCro.significance: This is a STRONGER form of confirmation than the engine's own test: it demonstrates the false-credit determination is not an artifact of the evaluator's own design choices, but is independently reproducible by reviewers reasoning from raw evidence alone under a general-purpose rubric. This binary-level finding is reliable specifically BECAUSE binary reproducibility passed both gates (94.9% original, 97.0% holdout) even though detailed-label reproducibility did not - the taxonomy's reliability problem is confined to the DETAILED state, not the underlying credit/no-credit judgment (see 12's gateEvaluation.verdict).

sacredNegativeControl.requirement: The case the ORIGINAL Phase 3F.1.5 second-pass reviewer incorrectly re-credited. No remediation in any subsequent phase may allow that false credit to return.
sacredNegativeControl.engineVerdict: Confirmed NO_CREDIT under the frozen v3 matcher (unchanged since 3F.1.5.2's confirmation).
sacredNegativeControl.adjudicatorVerdicts: All 3 independent adjudicators in this phase's 65-case study also assigned NO_CREDIT (detailed states varied - HONESTLY_UNSUPPORTED/DISCOVERED_REVIEW_REQUIRED/DISCOVERED_ONLY - but binary was unanimous). The false credit has not returned, corroborated by a fourth and fifth independent method beyond the engine's own test.

conclusion: PASS. Zero regression. All 14 false credits remain caught, now corroborated by three additional independent human-equivalent reviewers with no access to the evaluator's code or historical record - the strongest confirmation this control has received across all phases to date.
